```{r}
N_iter  <-1000 # Number of iterations
N_trial <- 200

Iterations <- 2500
Burn_in <- 2500

### Each Situation we wish to simulate through
ProgVar.types <- c("Categorical", "Continuous") 
Heterogeneity.types <- c("No_Heterogeneity", "Heterogeneity")
Noise.types <- c("Noise", "No_Noise")

### Generated trials
Sim_Trials <- list()

### Sim outcomes
Heterogeneity_List <- list()





### Things to add to output --------------------------------------------
### selection probs of models (individual and model) - Table x 2
### point estimate of beta3 heterogeneity - Value
### Trt Eff w/o intx (beta1) and Trt Eff w/ intx (beta1, 2, 3)
###     - Identify
### prediction error sum(y - y hat)^2/n noise + optimized
### CI's for risk and intx model (freq)
###     TRT Effect
### TRT0 <- beta1 
### TRT1 <- beta1 + beta3 RA for binary
### TRT0 <- beta1 + beta3 (x - xbar - 1.5sd) or beta3 (X_Q25)
### TRT1 <- beta1 + beta3 (x - xbar + 1.5sd) or beta3 (X_Q75)
```




### 1. No Heterogeneity -- Categorical Prognostic Variable -- Noise Variables

```{r}
Noise.type         <- Noise.types[1]
Heterogeneity.type <- Heterogeneity.types[1]
ProgVar.type       <- ProgVar.types[1]

Sim_Trials <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = c("tidyverse")) %dopar% {
  seed <- 1000000 + i
  Gen_Trial_Data(N_trial, seed, Heterogeneity.type, ProgVar.type, Noise.type)
}
```


```{r}
### Tracking Runtime 
start_time <- Sys.time()

### Simulation
Heterogeneity_List <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = required_packages) %dopar% {
    
  Trial_Data <- Sim_Trials[[i]]
    
  Heterogeneity <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                      SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                      Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                      Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity)
  
  if(Noise.type == "Noise") {
    Heterogeneity_Noise <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                              SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                              Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                              Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity,
                                              Optimized = FALSE) 
    }
  
  Alternative_Results <- Alternative_Methods(Trial_Data)
  
  Output <- Clean_Output(Trial_Data, Heterogeneity, Heterogeneity_Noise, Alternative_Methods, N_trial)
    
  list(Output = Output,
       Selection_Probability = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability},
       Variable_Selections = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections},
       R_hat_Heterogeneity = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat )) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat},
       R_hat_Risk = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat})
}

### Storing results seperately
Results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Output"))
Selection_Probability <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Selection_Probability")
Variable_Selections <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Variable_Selections")
R_hat_Heterogeneity <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Heterogeneity")
R_hat_Risk <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Risk")


### End runtime tracking
end_time <- Sys.time()
time_elapsed <- end_time - start_time; time_elapsed

Results |>
  summarise(
    Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.SDIR = sum(rejection.SDIR == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    SSVS.X1 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X1")),
    SSVS.X2 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X2"))
  )

path <- paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, ".csv")

write_csv(Results, path)

write_rds(Selection_Probability, paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/2-Selection_Probability/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, "-SelectProb.rds"))

write_rds(R_hat_Heterogeneity, paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/1-Diagnostics/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, "-R_hat_Heterogeneity.rds"))

write_rds(Variable_Selections, paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/3-Variable_Selection/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, "-Variable_Selections.rds"))

write_rds(R_hat_Risk, paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/1-Diagnostics/",
               "TrtEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, "-R_hat_Risk.rds"))
```


### 2. Heterogeneity -- Categorical Prognostic Variable -- Noise Variables

```{r}

Noise.type         <- Noise.types[1]

Sim_Trials <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = c("tidyverse")) %dopar% {
  seed <- 1000000 + i
  Gen_Trial_Data(N_trial, seed, Heterogeneity.type, ProgVar.type, Noise.type)
}
```


```{r}
### Tracking Runtime 
start_time <- Sys.time()

### Simulation
Heterogeneity_List <- foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .packages = required_packages) %dopar% {

                                              Optimized = FALSE) 
    }
  
  Alternative_Results <- Alternative_Methods(Trial_Data)
  
  Output <- Clean_Output(Trial_Data, Heterogeneity, Heterogeneity_Noise, Alternative_Methods, N_trial)
    
  list(Output = Output,
       Selection_Probability = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability},
       Variable_Selections = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections)) {"N/A"}

       R_hat_Heterogeneity = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat )) {"N/A"}

                               else{Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat})
}

### Storing results seperately
Results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Output"))
Selection_Probability <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Selection_Probability")
Variable_Selections <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Variable_Selections")
R_hat_Heterogeneity <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Heterogeneity")
R_hat_Risk <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Risk")


### End runtime tracking
end_time <- Sys.time()
time_elapsed <- end_time - start_time; time_elapsed

Results |>
  summarise(
    Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,

    SSVS.X1 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X1")),
    SSVS.X2 = sum(str_detect(SSVS_results, "X2"))
  )

path <- paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/",
               "TrtEff0.50-HetEff0.50",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, ".csv")

write_csv(Results, path)

write_rds(Selection_Probability, paste0("/deac/sta/beaversGrp/coucns24/Bayesian_RiskModel_TEH/Simulation_Study/Continuous_Outcomes/Output/2-Selection_Probability/",
               "TrtEff0.50-HetEff1.00",
               "N", N_trial, "-", Heterogeneity.type, "-", ProgVar.type, "-", Noise.type, "-SelectProb.rds"))
```
